reports.summary: Build A is a correct and carefully thread-safe implementation. Every spec requirement holds: available, reserve, commit and release work as specified, unknown SKUs raise UnknownProduct, catalog SKUs missing from the dict have 0 on hand, qty is validated, and each reservation settles at most once. My throwaway probes found no correctness or concurrency defects: tiny-switch-interval stress runs, concurrent double commits, huge quantities and bad SKU types all behaved correctly. ./check.sh passes. All remaining issues are minor: missing method docstrings, a mutable Reservation where a frozen dataclass would fit the codebase, a test suite heavier than the rest of the repo with somewhat paranoid adversarial cases, abandoned reservations held forever, and a one-line README mention.

reports.summary: Build A fixes the root cause. Previously, node.routes() dropped every endpoint on a node that held a Mount stub handler. Now each endpoint records a `stub` flag in setEndpoint, and routes() skips only the stub-written endpoints, so methods registered later on the same pattern (Get, Handle, MethodFunc, With) are reported. I verified in a copy that go test, go vet and gofmt are all clean. The new tests fail on the original tree.go and pass with the fix. A before/after diff of Walk output for a non-colliding router (Use/With/Group/Route, sub-mux Mount, raw-handler Mount, trailing-slash Mount, wildcard) shows no change. Every collision scenario I tried reports each method/pattern once, and routing still serves the right handlers (GET /foo/bar -> Get handler, POST /m -> raw mount, PATCH /b -> MethodFunc, etc.). A Get registered before Route on the same path is correctly not reported, because the mount stub overrides it. Remaining issues are minor: a slightly redundant node-level `stubbed` guard, tests that check only the listing and not routing, and a somewhat long test table. A CHANGELOG entry isn't expected, since the repo's changelog only links compare ranges per release.
